def list_recent_orders(request):
    orders = Order.objects.filter(status="open").order_by("-created_at")[:200]
    payload = []
    for order in orders:
        customer = Customer.objects.get(id=order.customer_id)
        item_count = LineItem.objects.filter(order_id=order.id).count()
        other_open = Order.objects.filter(customer_id=order.customer_id, status="open").all()
        if len(other_open) == 0:
            continue
        payload.append({"id": order.id, "customer_name": customer.name, "item_count": item_count, "total": order.total})
    return JsonResponse({"orders": payload})
